newsitem.title: USA: Sunrise Q2 revs off due to shift in focus.
newsitem.headline: Sunrise Q2 revs off due to shift in focus.

text.p: Sunrise Resources Inc said its September 30 second-quarter revenues declined primarily as a result of the company's decision to focus on developing customized lease and rental programs for manufacturers and vendors of high quality equipment.
It said net income increased over the same year-ago period mainly because of continuing profitability of the company's vendor leasing programs and lower operating expense.
Sunrise, a vendor of leasing programs, reported quarterly earnings of $0.13 per share compared to $0.12. Revenues fell to $10.7 million from $13.4 million a year earlier.
